title: 矽光子 SOI 波導製作
titleEn: SOI waveguide fabrication for silicon photonics
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入SOI 波導侷限、側壁散射與 cutback；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine soi confinement, sidewall scattering and cutback. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。波導尺寸須依實際 PDK；本課不把單一公開截面當成所有代工廠共通設計規則。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Waveguide dimensions must follow the actual PDK; one public cross-section is not a universal foundry rule.

stages.title: 模態與截面
stages.description: 本階段處理模態與截面：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address modes and cross-sections through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 畫出 SOI 截面
steps.titleEn: Draw SOI cross-section
steps.objective: 建立「畫出 SOI 截面」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：矽核心、埋氧與上包覆共同決定模態，不只核心寬度。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for draw soi cross-section: Silicon core, buried oxide and top cladding jointly determine modes.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。標記 strip 與 rib 的不同邊界。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. Mark differing strip and rib boundaries. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：標記 strip 與 rib 的不同邊界。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: Mark differing strip and rib boundaries. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：有效折射率與群折射率相同。本步先檢查「畫出 SOI 截面」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到矽核心、埋氧與上包覆共同決定模態，不只核心寬度。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Effective index equals group index. First check whether evidence for draw soi cross-section actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Silicon core, buried oxide and top cladding jointly determine modes.
steps.check: 交付「畫出 SOI 截面」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for draw soi cross-section, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.
